subject: general
question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 13,000 in 2 years at 4% p.a., interest compounded yearly.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 13,000

Rate of interest (R) = 4% per annum

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest (CI) = P × (1 + (R)/(100))T - P

**Calculation:**

First, calculate the amount (A):

A = P × (1 + (R)/(100))T

⇒ A = 13,000 × (1 + (4)/(100))²

⇒ A = 13,000 × (1 + 0.04)²

⇒ A = 13,000 × (1.04)²

⇒ A = 13,000 × 1.0816

⇒ A = 14,060.80

Now, calculate the compound interest (CI):

CI = A - P

⇒ CI = 14,060.80 - 13,000

⇒ CI = 1,060.80

**∴ The compound interest on Rs. 13,000 in 2 years at 4% p.a., interest compounded yearly, is Rs. 1,060.80.**
